name: Codecov Action
description: Test results and coverage reporting for GitHub Actions with multi-format support

token.description: GitHub token for API access and artifacts

files.description: Comma-separated explicit list of coverage files to process

directory.description: Folder to search for coverage files. Defaults to current working directory

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of folders/patterns to exclude from search

coverage-format.description: Coverage format hint (auto, clover, cobertura, jacoco, lcov, istanbul, go). Auto-detects if not specified

disable-search.description: Disable automatic search for coverage files. Use with "files" input

fail-ci-if-error.description: Exit with non-zero code if coverage processing fails

handle-no-reports-found.description: Do not fail if no coverage reports are found

flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags to tag this coverage upload (e.g., unittests, frontend)

name.description: Custom name for this coverage upload. Visible in reports

base-branch.description: Base branch to compare results against. Auto-detects the repo's default branch if not specified

junit-xml-pattern.description: Glob pattern for finding JUnit XML files

post-pr-comment.description: Post results as a PR comment (in addition to Job Summary)

fail-on-error.description: Fail the CI job if coverage thresholds are not met

target-project.description: Target project coverage % (or 'auto' to use base branch coverage)

threshold-project.description: Allowed project coverage drop % (only used when target is 'auto')

target-patch.description: Target patch coverage % for changed lines

coverage-xml-pattern.description: [Deprecated] Glob pattern for finding coverage XML files. Use files/directory instead.
